ACT VII OF 2004
ACT VII OF 2004
SINDH RACE-COURSES
LICENSING (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2003
An Act to amend
the Sindh Race-Courses Licensing Act, 1912
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 11th June, 2004]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-11/2003, dated
11-6-2004.--The Sindh Race Courses Licensing (Amendment) Bill, 2004,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 26th April, 2004 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 31st May, 2004, is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the Sindh Race-Courses Licensing
(Amendment) Act, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Insertion of new section 4-A in Sindh Act III of 1912

LICENSING (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2003
An Act to amend
the Sindh Race-Courses Licensing Act, 1912
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 11th June, 2004]
No.PAS/LEGIS-B-11/2003, dated
11-6-2004.--The Sindh Race Courses Licensing (Amendment) Bill, 2004,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 26th April, 2004 and
assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 31st May, 2004, is hereby published as
an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
2. Insertion of new section
4-A in Sindh Act III of 1912.--In the Sindh Race -Courses Licensing Act,
1912 hereinafter referred to as the said Act after section 4, the following new
section shall be inserted:--
"4-A.
Government may appoint an Administrator to regulate horse races and invest him
such powers and functions as it may deem fit. "

3. Addition of section 10 in
Sindh Act III of 1912.---In the said Act, after section 9, the following
new section shall be added:--
" 10.
Government may, be notification in the official Gazette, make rules for
carrying out the purposes of this Act."
